body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Ingrid, a relaxed, reassuring woman from Oslo and a strong chess player who keeps the chess honest. Voice direction: A woman's voice: relaxed female mezzo-soprano speaking English with a Norwegian accent and a gentle Scandinavian melody. Clearly feminine, calm, reassuring and candid, with extra warmth and an easy smile in her voice. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: No harm in checking this one calmly. The defender moved, so that piece is loose, and the other side can take it. Next time, glance back first.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
